answer: Give each agent a rotating audit lottery whose ticket is drawn from an atlas of independent peers. A selected head must reveal signed counterfactual receipts showing what it would have done under several random tasks; fabricating many identities then requires producing distinct, time-consistent evidence for every ticket. The tide of fresh assignments prevents rehearsal, while a garden of linked receipts lets auditors detect copied decision paths and quarantine the whole cluster without penalizing unrelated honest agents.
